overloadMerges.semanticRole: Copies field values (or record numbers, if a Table is passed instead of a Field) from the selected-record range [start, end] of the current selection into one or more output arrays.
overloadMerges.note: autoparse defaulted the repeat-group's array member direction to 'in'; the doc arrow column marks array as an out-parameter filled by the command (data stays 'in').

constraints: Requires 1 <= start <= end <= Records in selection([...]); the command still works if start = end (loads/returns data for that single selected record).
If end exceeds Records in selection([...]), returns values from the selected record at start through the last selected record.
If start > end, returns values only from the record at start.
If both start and end are inconsistent with the size of the selection, returns empty arrays.

Applies to the current selection of the table specified by the first data/table parameter's table; passing a Table instead of a Field for data loads record numbers into a Long Integer array instead of field values.
Values can be loaded from related fields via an automatic Many-to-One relation (including through several relation levels), including relations made automatic via SET AUTOMATIC RELATIONS.
Calling with only start and end (omitting every data/array pair) is a special syntax to launch, on a limited range, a previously deferred SELECTION TO ARRAY sequence.
